find_adsorbate_binding_sites: run find_adsorbate_binding_sites to search for adsorbate binding sites on surfaces of a bulk material using the OCP API
get_adsorbate_slab_relaxation_results: fetch adsorbate slab relaxation results by system_id with optional config_ids and fields filters
wait_for_adsorbate_slab_relaxations: wait for all adsorbate slab relaxations in a system to finish and return their terminal statuses
Lifetime_enum: use the Lifetime enum to choose SAVE, MARK_EPHEMERAL, or DELETE for relaxation data retention on API servers
AdsorbateBindingSites_dataclass: review the AdsorbateBindingSites dataclass to access adsorbate, bulk, model, and slabs relaxation results
